req.title: Redirect preserves relative or absolute style
req.statement: The system shall emit relative URLs on /redirect/<n> and absolute URLs on /absolute-redirect/<n>.
triggers: redirect preserves relative or absolute style

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/<n> emits relative URLs (no scheme/host) and GET /absolute-redirect/<n> emits absolute URLs (with scheme+host). The source shows redirect_n_times uses request.args 'absolute' flag to switch between relative and absolute. Key mutations to kill: off-by-one on n, wrong URL style (relative vs absolute), wrong status code, wrong Location header format. Tests cover: positive relative redirect, positive absolute redirect (via query param), boundary n=1 (the special-case branch in source), negative n=0 (assert fails), and multi-hop chain verification.

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_relative_location
preconditions: n=1 triggers the n==1 branch in redirect_n_times
expected: Location header is a relative URL (starts with '/', no scheme)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_relative_location():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    # Must be relative: starts with '/' and must NOT contain '://'
    assert location.startswith('/')
    assert '://' not in location

test_redirect_n1_relative_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_absolute_via_query_param
preconditions: absolute=true query param switches to absolute URL generation
expected: Location header contains '://' (absolute URL with scheme)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: absolute URL on /redirect/<n> when absolute=true
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_absolute_via_query_param():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    # Must be absolute: contains scheme separator
    assert '://' in location
    # Must point to /get endpoint
    assert location.endswith('/get')

test_redirect_n1_absolute_via_query_param()

tests.name: test_redirect_boundary_n1_is_minimum_valid
preconditions: n=1 is the minimum valid value (assert n > 0)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-042: BVA at n=1 boundary; catches off-by-one mutation n>0 -> n>1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_boundary_n1_is_minimum_valid():
    # n=1: valid, should redirect
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    # n=0: invalid, assert n>0 fires -> 500
    r0 = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r0.status_code == 500
    # Confirm they differ (catches mutation that makes both succeed)
    assert r1.status_code != r0.status_code

test_redirect_boundary_n1_is_minimum_valid()

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_relative_does_not_contain_scheme
preconditions: n=1 special-case branch uses url_for with _external=False
actions: assert Location has no http:// or https://
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_n1_relative_does_not_contain_scheme():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert not location.startswith('http')
    assert location.startswith('/')
    assert location == '/get'
